reason: B is the better proposal because it specifies one compositionally defined intervention, a matched baseline, explicit temperature/load/environment tests, measurable outcomes, and a falsification rule, whereas A leaves the additive undefined and therefore is not decisively testable. However, B overextends evidence from Al-containing HEA coatings tested at high temperature to bulk CoCrFeNi across room temperature–800 °C and air/vacuum, and its claimed W-derived lubricious tribofilm and numerical performance targets remain weakly supported.
